title: The Mission in the Ancient City
intro: A dusty ancient town, its people entrenched in denial, and a final warning that went unheeded. Today, step into the role of those sent by Allah to deliver a message to a stubborn people. A story of rejection, a singular voice of faith, and an ending sealed by a devastating decree. Who speaks through these clues?
clues: We were sent by Allah to a town whose people had turned away from truth
Two of us came first, then a third joined to strengthen our mission
The townsfolk rejected us, saying we were nothing but humans like them
A single soul from the farthest end of the city ran to tell the people to follow us
We pled with them, but they hardened their hearts and turned against us
In one devastating cry from the heavens, our entire city was silenced

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Messengers of the Town in Surah Ya-Sin
The Hawwariyyun (Disciples of Isa)
The Sorcerers of Pharaoh's Court
The Companions of the Sabbath
The People of the Elephant
identity.answer: The Messengers of the Town in Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Rejected and called liars by the townspeople
Burned alive in a great blazing fire
Swallowed by a great fish in the deep sea
Forced to labor building a towering pillar
Tortured in a trench of raging fire
trial.answer: Rejected and called liars by the townspeople

location.label: Key Element
options: The ancient town (al-Qaryah)
A great blazing furnace
The belly of a great fish
The lofty sky-touching pillar
The sacred House (Kaaba)

outcome.label: Outcome
options: The town was destroyed by a single devastating cry (Sayha)
The tyrant and his army were drowned in the parted sea
The people were transformed into apes and monkeys
A rain of stones from the sky destroyed the city
A violent flood swept away the entire community
outcome.answer: The town was destroyed by a single devastating cry (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
